chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man about 35, short black hair, neatly trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow knit sweater over a white collared shirt and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman about 30, long dark wavy hair, gold hoop earrings, wearing an emerald-green satin blouse and black wide-leg trousers
chars.NEIGHBOUR: a handsome Moroccan young man about 27, slick wavy hair, thin silver chain, wearing a burgundy leather bomber jacket over a black t-shirt and light grey jeans
chars.FATHER: an older Moroccan man about 60, grey moustache, wearing a cream djellaba and a brown wool cap

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, seen from a half-open doorway of a Casablanca apartment hallway during a family party: the WIFE secretly hugs the NEIGHBOUR tightly, both glance around guiltily, faces visible, head-to-waist framing, guests blurred far behind

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, in a modest Moroccan living room the WIFE holds a newborn baby wrapped in a white blanket while the NEIGHBOUR leans in and whispers to her with a sly grin, a stack of dirham banknotes on the low table, scheming mood

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, at night in a dim Moroccan kitchen the HUSBAND grips the edge of the counter with both hands, jaw clenched, eyes burning with anger, trying to hold himself back, single warm lamp

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, in a Moroccan hospital room the HUSBAND calmly places a folder of divorce papers on the bedside table, the WIFE sits in the hospital bed staring at him in shock, his face composed and quiet

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, the HUSBAND walks calmly out of a Moroccan hospital entrance into the daylight, head high, hands in pockets, relieved expression, palm trees and parked taxis in the background

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, the HUSBAND sits alone on a Casablanca apartment balcony at sunset with a glass of mint tea, thinking deeply, rooftops and satellite dishes behind him

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, at the door of a Moroccan apartment the HUSBAND calmly and politely closes the door while the WIFE stands outside crying holding a baby, the FATHER beside her lowering his head in shame, the husband dignified

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon, close-up of the HUSBAND in his apartment looking straight ahead with a calm, serious, questioning expression, one eyebrow slightly raised, soft evening light
